name: Chau Doc Market
kicker: Town market for the morning bowl
summary: Start at Chợ Châu Đốc. Vietnam Tourism puts fish-noodle bowls and coffee on the outskirts, boats unloading on the waterfront, and flowers, fruit, and vegetables on the sidewalk. Mắm ferments in the open. A street number and a closing hour were not printed. Check on arrival for the gate. Come in the morning, before the hill.
getThere: In the town center, phường Châu Đốc. The street number is check on arrival.
heroCaption: The market hall signed Chợ Châu Đốc
body: Walk the hall for breakfast, not for a list of named stalls. On the outskirts, bún cá and strong coffee. On the waterfront, boats unload produce. Mắm, fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic, is stacked in the open. Tamarind, jellied sweets, and fish fill the aisles. Vietnam Tourism also tells you to look up at the old shop-sign lettering.

The photographs are two halls, both signed Chợ Châu Đốc: the fan-window front, and the blue hall with the street in front. They are the market. They are not a close frame of the bowl. Bún cá is the breakfast to order, with chili and lime. A stall price was not published.

A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival. Shop names that only located a street, including stalls on Phan Đình Phùng, are not picks. A company project called Chợ quê làng Chăm in Đa Phước is a 2024 notice, not a second market this page can walk.

gettingThere: The market is in the town center, phường Châu Đốc. Vietnam Tourism does not print a street number. Check the gate on arrival. If your room is on the river, walk. Minutes from a bungalow on Núi Sam were not printed.

legs.body: On foot, into the town center. A published minute count was not found. Check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. Come in the morning for breakfast and the landing.
